sentence_stem: Had the committee been given more time to review the evidence,
correct_completion: it would have reached a far more nuanced verdict.
full_sentence: Had the committee been given more time to review the evidence, it would have reached a far more nuanced verdict.
acceptable_variants: the panel would have weighed the findings more carefully.
its judgement would have been considerably more balanced.

options.text: it reaches a far more nuanced verdict.
options.why_wrong: The present tense does not match the hypothetical past condition set up by the inverted 'Had'. The main clause must express an unrealized past result.

options.text: it was reaching a more nuanced verdict.
options.why_wrong: The past continuous describes an ongoing past action, not the hypothetical result of a condition that did not happen.

options.text: so the verdict had been nuanced.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result of a stated fact. The stem sets up a hypothetical condition, so the continuation must be a conditional consequence.

options.text: it would have reached a far more nuanced verdict.

grammar_focus: Inverted third conditional with 'Had' in a formal register
explanation: Inverted conditionals drop 'if' and move 'had' to the front of the clause. The main clause must then use would have plus a past participle to express the hypothetical result. Learners whose first language marks unreal past meaning with a different grammatical device often leave out the would have structure, so the main clause needs this full form to complete the condition.
translation: Якби комітету дали більше часу на розгляд доказів, він ухвалив би набагато зваженіший висновок.
